name: AgentTeams
maker_comment_excerpt: Hey Product Hunt! 👋 I'm Susanne from the AgentTeams team. We built AgentTeams because most AI tools still feel like tools: you prompt, copy, paste, repeat. We wanted AI that works the way a great teammate does: you hire it for a role, give it context, and it gets on with the job. With AgentTeams you can: Hire AI agents for specific roles: support, engineering, marketing and more Organize them into teams that work together like virtual employees Manage and track their work in one place We'd love
